title: Neutrino Oscillation Constraints from Long-Baseline Data
abstract: We present a reproducible study of neutrino oscillation constraints from long-baseline data using open-source workflows. The analysis compares baseline estimators against a modern ML-assisted variant, reports uncertainty decomposition, and validates key claims on held-out data. Results highlight both performance gains and failure modes relevant to physics inference.
